name: save-boot-3-player-model-nmkin-1
description: #99 acceptance, the second field: boot from the generated save harness/saves/disc1-nmkin-1.json (nmkin_1, field ID 0x78 per ff7-flat-wiki Field_ID; triangle 0, x 0x7FFF so the game places the player at the triangle's centroid, as #38 did; progress 6 and Cloud alone as at md1stin). Load as save-boot-1-load does. g_PlayerModelId reads 0 (model_ok), and after a walk up 40 and right 40 frames the PosX and PosY of field model 0 have changed (x_dir, y_dir: signs since the load) while model 1's PosX has not (other_still). So g_PlayerModelId names the model that the pad moves, in a field other than md1stin. #99 attempts 1 and 2 (notes/99-player-model.md) found no reachable state where it is not 0. match: a rerun from the title snapshot ends in the same state.
